thesis: GMAB is a profitable, high-margin oncology royalty name (operating margin 0.3063, FCF 854.9M) digesting a fundamental late-October re-rating, pulling back on fading volume (ratio 0.66, RSI14 55) to its 10-day low of 50.24 above a rising SMA50 (42.98), and healthcare (XLV) is one of only three sectors holding up in a risk-off tape. Reward/risk from the 50.85 entry midpoint to the 57.3 target versus the 49.4 stop is about 4.4, so the trade has positive expectancy even at a low hit rate. Conviction is low: the stop is only about 0.7 ATR away, the post-gap sequence is lower highs and lower lows, and the regime is risk-off at 0.95 confidence, so this is a small-size Overweight, not a Buy.
invalidation: A daily close below 49.4 (under the 10-day low of 50.24) invalidates the pullback and opens a gap-fill toward the 20-day low of 43.98.
key_risks: Stop is about 0.7 ATR (2.03) from entry, so noise alone can trigger it; the next real support is the 44-45 gap-fill zone, so a gap through the stop could lose more than the -2.9% shown
Broad risk-off regime (QQQ 21-day -13.63%, VIX 31.34 at the 0.991 percentile) could hit a stock that has roughly doubled in six months as funds raise cash
Lower highs and lower lows since the 10/28 gap (57.06, 55.8, 53.87, 52.4); the 10/05, 10/23 and 10/28 jumps have no verified news cause
Valuation stretched on earnings (trailing PE 43.25, forward PE 32.03) with earnings growth -0.147 and total debt 5.198B above cash 1.871B; SEC quarterly series empty and next earnings date unknown
Correlated healthcare exposure: per lessons, cap combined healthcare weight rather than sizing GMAB alone
